lines.text: The three men stopped answering Job, and Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite burned with anger against Job.
Elihu burned with anger at the three friends for condemning Job without refuting him, and he had waited because they were older.
Elihu said he was timid because he was young, but the breath of the Almighty gives a man understanding.
Elihu said he listened to the friends, that no one proved Job wrong, and that he would not answer with their arguments.
Elihu said he was full of words like a river about to flood, and he would flatter no one.
